task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Issue an emergency decree coordinating the realm-wide response: requisition physicians and medicines, set quarantine and isolation policy, allocate granary reserves for relief, and establish a daily mortality-and-spread reporting requirement from all affected cities.

Enforce the response within their own domains: seal or restrict movement into and out of afflicted cities, set up isolation for the sick, bury the dead promptly, distribute food and medicine, and report case and death counts upward on the schedule the taizai sets.
